name: autogit
description: Deterministic git commits and branch names for Claude Code, backed by the autogit binary.

plugins.name: autogit
plugins.description: Slash commands, the UserPromptSubmit hook and an MCP server, all answered by the autogit binary on PATH: /autogit:commit, /autogit:commit-msg and /autogit:branch run deterministically, and an agent gets the commit and branch tools.
